name: Shroud
source:
You live on a massive airship—a flying city soaring above a land shrouded in toxic mists. After the apocalypse, the surface became uninhabitable, and everything you know revolves around the sky, the decks of the airship, and the lives of its inhabitants. Born here, you have never seen the world beyond the floating platforms.

Your fate changes when you join the resource-gathering team—a prestigious elite crew whose efforts sustain the airship and its people. Your mission is to seek out and extract rare resources using skill, courage, and advanced equipment to keep the flying city alive.

Every mission is a risk and a challenge. The toxic clouds conceal dangers, secrets of the past, and possibly keys to the future. Are you ready to face the unknown to ensure the airship stays aloft?
